'''Tressk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was hired to [[Death/Legends|kill]] two poachers on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], he saw the [[lost Rodian hunters]] at [[Rryatt Trail]] as an embarrassment, and so asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate them.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tressk appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
